scripts.start: if [ ! -d .git ]; then git init && git remote add origin https://github.com/ffaniagung-beep/nexa-bot.git && git fetch origin main && git reset --hard origin/main && git branch -M main && git branch --set-upstream-to=origin/main main; else git pull --ff-only origin main; fi && mkdir -p "$PWD/temp" && TMPDIR="$PWD/temp" npm install && TMPDIR="$PWD/temp" node index.js
